healthy: a uniformly green leaf with no spots, lesions or discoloration
rust: small orange to reddish-brown powdery pustules, mostly on the leaf underside
common_rust: small cinnamon-brown powdery pustules scattered on both leaf surfaces
brown_rust: small round orange-brown powdery pustules scattered on the leaf
yellow_rust: yellow powdery pustules arranged in stripes along the leaf
stripe_rust: yellow powdery pustules arranged in long stripes between the veins
bean_rust: small reddish-brown powdery pustules with yellow halos
cedar_apple_rust: bright yellow-orange spots with tiny black dots in the centre
red_rust: raised orange-red velvety spots on the leaf surface
powdery_mildew: white to grey powdery fungal growth on the leaf surface
mildew: white or grey fungal growth on the leaf surface
downy_mildew: yellow angular patches on top and grey-purple fuzzy growth underneath
anthracnose: dark sunken irregular lesions with brown margins, dead leaf tips and edges
brown_spot: round brown spots, often with a yellow halo
spot: small round brown or black spots on the leaf
bacterial_spot: small dark water-soaked spots that turn brown, with yellow halos
bacterial_leaf_spot: small dark water-soaked spots that turn brown, with yellow halos
black_rot: brown to black dead lesions with dark margins and yellowing
black_spot: round black spots with feathery edges and yellowing around them
leaf_blight: large brown dead areas spreading from the leaf edges or tips
blight_leaf: large brown dead areas spreading from the leaf edges or tips
alternaria_leaf_spot: brown spots with concentric rings and a yellow halo
alternaria_leaf_blight: brown spots with concentric rings that merge into large dead areas
alternaria_blotch: small round brown blotches with darker borders
early_blight: brown spots with concentric target-like rings and yellow surrounding tissue
late_blight: large dark water-soaked lesions with pale green edges and white mould underneath
target_spot: brown spots with concentric rings like a target
mosaic_virus: mottled light green, dark green and yellow patches with distorted leaves
mosaic: mottled light green, dark green and yellow patches with distorted leaves
yellow_mosaic: bright yellow and green mosaic patches
yellow_mosaic_virus: bright yellow and green mosaic patches
curl: leaves curled, puckered and thickened, often reddish or yellow
curl_virus: leaves curled upward, crinkled and yellowed
yellow_leaf_curl_virus: small leaves curled upward with yellow edges
scab: olive-green to black velvety spots that become corky
monillia_laxa: brown rotted and wilted tissue with grey spore tufts
brown_rot: brown rotting areas with grey-brown spore tufts
cercospora: small round spots with grey centres and dark reddish margins
cercospora_leaf_blight: purple to dark brown blighted areas spreading across the leaf
frogeye_leaf_spot: round spots with grey centres and purple-brown borders
frog_eye_leaf_spot: round spots with grey centres and purple-brown borders
loose_smut: black powdery spore masses replacing the grain head
bacterial_blight: water-soaked angular lesions that turn brown, with yellow margins
angular_leaf_spot: angular water-soaked spots bounded by veins that turn brown
bacterial_leaf_streak: narrow translucent streaks between veins that turn brown
scorch: brown dry leaf margins and tips
septoria_leaf_spot: many small round spots with dark borders and grey centres with tiny black dots
septoria: many small round spots with dark borders and grey centres
ring_spot: yellow or brown rings on the leaf
sheath_blight: oval grey-green lesions with brown borders
spider_mites: fine yellow stippling and bronzed leaves with thin webbing
gray_mold: grey fuzzy mould on brown rotting tissue
phytophthora: dark water-soaked lesions with rapid blight and wilting
fusarium_wilt: yellowing and wilting leaves, often on one side of the plant
canker: raised corky brown lesions with yellow halos
leaf_mold: pale yellow spots on top and olive-green velvety mould underneath
sooty_mould: black powdery coating on the leaf surface
gray_leaf_spot: rectangular grey to tan lesions between the veins
blast: diamond-shaped lesions with grey centres and brown borders
leafblast: diamond-shaped lesions with grey centres and brown borders
northern_leaf_blight: long cigar-shaped grey-green to tan lesions
streak_virus: thin yellow streaks along the veins
sigatoka: streaks that become dark brown elongated spots with grey centres
segatoka: streaks that become dark brown elongated spots with grey centres
black_leaf_streak: dark brown to black streaks that merge into dead patches
aphis_spp: clusters of small soft-bodied aphids on curled sticky leaves
nutrition_deficiency: yellowing or purpling between the veins with no spots
white_spot: small round white or pale spots on the leaf
